evidence.commentary: I recall that Public Health England published combined influenza and COVID-19 surveillance reports during the pandemic, but the exact start date is uncertain in my knowledge. The verification results contain multiple sources actively contradicting the claim, stating that combined reports were already in place before October 8, 2020, or that separate reports continued, with no official records or news coverage confirming the transition on that date.
